title: Oracle Against Moab

questions.question: Because Ar of Moab is laid waste in a night, Moab is what?
Dibon has gone up to the high places to do what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 15:2 (ESV): "Dibon has gone up to the high places to weep;"

questions.question: On every head is baldness; every beard is what?
In the streets they wear what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 15:3 (ESV): "In the streets they wear sackcloth;"

questions.question: Because Kir of Moab is laid waste in a night, Moab is what?
Heshbon and Elealeh cry out; their voice is heard as far as where?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 15:4 (ESV): "their voice is heard as far as Jahaz;"

questions.question: My heart cries out for Moab; his fugitives flee to where?
For the waters of Nimrim are a what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 15:6 (ESV): "For the waters of Nimrim are a desolation;"

questions.question: The grass is withered, the vegetation fails, the greenery is what?
Therefore the abundance they have gained and what they have laid up they carry away over the Brook of the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 15:7 (ESV): "over the Brook of the Willows."

questions.question: For a cry has gone around the land of Moab; its wailing reaches to Eglaim, and its wailing to where?
For the waters of Dibon are full of what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 15:9 (ESV): "For the waters of Dibon are full of blood;"

questions.question: For I will bring upon Dibon even more, a lion for those of Moab who what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 15:9 (ESV): "a lion for those of Moab who escape,"

questions.question: And for the remnant of the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 15:9 (ESV): "and for the remnant of the land."

key_verse_text: An oracle concerning Moab. Because Ar of Moab is laid waste in a night, Moab is undone; because Kir of Moab is laid waste in a night, Moab is undone.
